rationale: The dispute concerns tailor-made environmental regulations (maatwerkvoorschriften under the Activiteitenbesluit milieubeheer) imposed on a manure/fertilizer pellet processing facility in Helmond due to excessive odour nuisance (geurhinder). Under the coding protocol, manure processing and odour nuisance permits without a substantive water governance or water infrastructure dispute are classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
